textSelection.description: The exact text on the page to anchor the inline comment to. Must match the rendered page text exactly (case-sensitive).

name: createConfluencePage
description: Create a Confluence page or blog post. When contentFormat is "html" or omitted because HTML is the default, first call the getContentFormatGuide tool with { toolName: "createConfluencePage" } and follow the returned HTML-format guidance. Do not call it when contentFormat is "markdown".

parentId.description: ID of the parent to nest the new page under. Accepts the ID of any container that can hold a page — a page, folder, whiteboard, database, embed, or slide (smart links surface as embeds). Applies to pages only; ignored for blog posts.

body.description: Page body. When contentFormat is "html" or omitted, author this field using the HTML-format guidance returned by the getContentFormatGuide tool for createConfluencePage.

contentFormat.description: Body format. HTML is the default. When contentFormat is "html" or omitted, first call the getContentFormatGuide tool with { toolName: "createConfluencePage" } and follow the returned HTML-format guidance. Prefer HTML. Use "markdown" only when you are confident the content needs only basic text formatting and has no rich Confluence elements to create, such as panels, layouts, or media. If unsure, use HTML.

subtype.description: Page subtype (pages only, ignored for blogs)

Use this tool before authoring HTML/default page bodies or fine-grained HTML edits. First call with only `toolName`; if the returned guidance references a follow-up document, call this tool again with the same `toolName` and `reference` set to that single referenced path. name: search
description: Search Jira, Confluence and linked 3P data using Rovo Search, ALWAYS use this tool to search for Jira and Confluence content unless the word CQL or JQL is used in the context. The utilisation of this tool may consume up to 10 Rovo Credits. If the user or organization does not have any Rovo Credits available, the tool call will fail.

cloudId.description: Not needed for this tool — cloudId is derived from your access token automatically

query.description: The search query to use for Rovo Search

name: searchConfluenceUsingCql
description: Search Confluence content (pages, blog posts, comments, attachments) using CQL (Confluence Query Language). CQL is specific to Confluence and is not interchangeable with JQL.

cql.description: CQL (Confluence Query Language) query string. CQL is specific to Confluence and is not JQL. Common fields: title, text, space, type, creator, contributor, label, ancestor, parent, lastmodified, created, mention, watcher, space.title, space.key. Use space key (not name) for the space field; use space.title ~ "name" for name search. Content types: page, blogpost, comment, attachment. Escape inner quotes with backslash: title ~ "Q2 \"planning\" review". Examples: title ~ "meeting notes" AND type = page | space.title ~ "Engineering" AND lastmodified >= now("-2w") AND type = page | creator = currentUser() AND type = page | text ~ "Q2 \"planning\" review" AND type = page

cqlcontext.description: CQL context for narrowing search scope (e.g., spaceKey)

name: searchJiraIssuesUsingJql

fields.description: Issue fields to return. When omitted or empty, defaults to: summary, description, status, issuetype, priority, labels, components, assignee, reporter, created, updated, resolution, project. Pass "*all" to return every field (including custom fields). Include "comment" to fetch issue comments in fields.comment.comments.

searchResultMode.description: Default "issues". Never count for normal search or if nextPageToken used. If total for same query is known, reuse it. name: updateConfluencePage
description: Update a Confluence page or blog post. When contentFormat is "html" or omitted because HTML is the default, first call the getContentFormatGuide tool with { toolName: "updateConfluencePage" } and follow the returned HTML-format guidance. Do not call it when contentFormat is "markdown".

pageId.description: Page or blog post ID, or a Confluence tiny link ID (the encoded part from /wiki/x/ URLs, e.g., Fc1bBw)

contentType.description: Type of content: page or blog post

status.description: "current" (default) publishes the body: it updates a published page, or publishes a never-published draft. Use "draft" to save changes to a draft without publishing it.

spaceId.description: Optional numeric space ID (a Long, e.g. "131073"). A space key (e.g. "ENG") or personal-space key (e.g. "~712020abc") is also accepted and resolved to the numeric ID automatically. Provide only for an actual move; omit when the space is unchanged.

parentId.description: ID of the parent to move the page under. Accepts the ID of any container that can hold a page — a page, folder, whiteboard, database, embed, or slide (smart links surface as embeds). Applies to pages only; ignored for blog posts.

body.description: Replacement page body. When contentFormat is "html" or omitted, author this field using the HTML-format guidance returned by the getContentFormatGuide tool for updateConfluencePage.

contentFormat.description: Body format. HTML is the default. When contentFormat is "html" or omitted, first call the getContentFormatGuide tool with { toolName: "updateConfluencePage" } and follow the returned HTML-format guidance. Prefer HTML. Use "markdown" only when you are confident the content needs only basic text formatting and has no rich Confluence elements to preserve or create, such as panels, layouts, or media. If unsure, use HTML.

includeBody.description: If true, include the page body in the response; if false, omit it to reduce payload size.
